items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Martin Block, for example, was one disk jockey I listened to while I was in high school.

ctx.x: Because the band was not popular, and people didn’t know – when I say people, disk jockeys. Martin Block, for example, was one disk jockey I listened to while I was in high school. It was a very commercial program, but he did play Armstrong, for example. He probably played Fletcher Henderson. He certainly played Fats Waller.
Were the other bands – was it easier for the other bands to be heard because they were white?
